chapter: Suntaug Lake Inn and Duke Ellington's band
title: Starting to copy for Duke in 1940
summary: After the theatre closed in 1940 Duke wanted a copyist, and in 1942 in Hollywood Whaley copied 'Black, Brown and Beige'.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: What did you say again, you started copying for Duke.

In 1940, you know, I was at the theatre and the girls in 1940, they wanted more money and the man wouldn't give them any more money so they closed them up and closed my job out also, so I was hanging around, so I don't know how, but I got in contact with Duke or Duke got in contact with me and sure, I says, I thought I was going to arrange, see, but he said he wanted a copier, so I said I'll go ahead and copy.
And in '42, we went to Hollywood and I was copying this "Black, Brown and Beige" and oh, this thing, "Come Sunday"
